Name: Moab, Son of Lot
Summary: Moab was the son of Lot by his elder daughter, born in the cave after Sodom's destruction, and the ancestor of the Moabites.
KeyStory: Lot's elder daughter, believing no man remained to continue the family, bore Moab, whose descendants became the nation of Moab.
RelatedPeople: Lot; Lot's Wife; Ben-ammi, Son of Lot
LifeLesson: Even a story born in failure can be redeemed: Ruth the Moabite would one day join the line of Christ.
